Merchant of record for software: stores, products, orders, subscriptions, license keys.

## API key

1. Open [app.lemonsqueezy.com](https://app.lemonsqueezy.com/settings/api) and create an API key with only the access your apps need.
2. Copy it. It may be shown only once.

**What to create:** An API key from Settings > API in Lemon Squeezy.

Add it to your Gateway. It asks for the key:

```bash
everyapp provider add lemonsqueezy
```

### Use it in an app

In the app's `everyapp.config.ts`:

```ts
capabilities: {
  lemonsqueezy: { access: "read", why: "What the app does with it." },
},
```

The app calls Lemon Squeezy's [API](https://docs.lemonsqueezy.com/api) with `integrationFetch()`, and the Gateway adds the key. Use `"write"` if the app changes things. More in [API providers](/docs/agent/providers).

**Check it worked:** `everyapp provider show lemonsqueezy` shows the key as set.

**Rate limits:** 300 a minute. 300 API calls per minute.

Something wrong or missing? [Open an issue](https://github.com/every-app/every-app/issues/new?template=provider-request.yml&title=Provider%20guide%3A%20Lemon%20Squeezy).
